_comment: Shared by every widget rather than set per panel: this is a property of how you use the terminal, not of one widget.
_mouse_comment: Shared by every widget, not set per panel - every settings screen offers this same key. Whether widgets ask the terminal for mouse reports, so the wheel scrolls and a click moves the cursor. While reporting is on, dragging selects nothing; turn it off if copying terminal text matters more. Every key still works either way - the mouse never reaches anything the keyboard cannot.
